problem.display_name: Lab: Triage a Week of Work

multiplechoiceresponse.p: An AI tool drafts replies to billing questions. An agent checks the account facts and sends. Which tier is this?

choice.div: Use with review — cheap to check, costly if wrong, reversible until send.
Use now — the draft is just text.
Do not use — billing is always off limits.

div.p: The work is assisted, but a named person verifies account facts before the reply leaves. That review is the control.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: The same assistant is allowed to issue refunds without review. What changed?

choice.div: Cost and reversibility — the output now acts before a person can catch it.
Nothing; the text task is unchanged.

div.p: Task tier follows consequence, not the kind of output. Issuing money is a decision with immediate, hard-to-reverse effect, so it is not delegated.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Which task belongs in "do not use" for an AI assistant?

choice.div: Deciding whether an employee's performance meets the standard for dismissal.
Outlining a training session from your own notes.

div.p: Decisions about a person's rights or livelihood must be made and owned by people, with evidence and a process — not generated.

choiceresponse.p: Which questions belong in a task-fit triage? Select all that apply.

choice.div: What does a wrong answer cost?
Can the output be withdrawn before it acts?
How long does it take a person to check the result?
How impressive does the output look to a client?

div.p: Triage is about consequence, reversibility and the cost of verification. Appearance is not a control.
